## Description

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Open a project using this template in your agent tool
2. Run a skill (`/<skill>`), a role, or `python tools/studio.py <command>`
3. ...
4. See error

## Expected Behavior

What you expected to happen.

## Actual Behavior

What actually happened. Include any error messages or unexpected output.

- **Python version**: (run `python --version`; 3.11 or newer is required)
